ratings.notes: Solid mechanistic coverage with cited PMIDs. Limitations well-stated. Missing clinical trial data and some mechanistic depth. Graph-derived note adds little value.
Good PMID-grounded evidence, clear limitations including causality caveat. Answer truncated mid-sentence, reducing completeness. Lung cancer reference adds breadth.
Most comprehensive: covers in vitro, xenograft, and clinical trial data. No PMIDs cited, reducing grounding score. Solvent/vehicle limitation is a unique valuable point.
Well-structured with PMID citations, testable hypotheses, and clear limitations. Mechanistically coherent. Slightly less comprehensive than C on clinical evidence.

result.pairwise_reason: PP002-C provides the broadest evidence base spanning in vitro, animal xenograft, and early clinical trial data, includes unique methodological caveats (solvent effects, model-specific dosing), and offers the most mechanistically coherent and complete synthesis, despite lacking explicit PMID citations.
